library.timePolicy: n/60 normalized to first decoded source PTS; nearest preceding real frame; last held until ceil(stream duration*60)
library.ptsPolicy: same FFmpeg decode pipeline showinfo native n+integer PTS, stream time_base; never infer timestamps from packet count
library.duplicateStorage: NTFS hardlink for each JPG sample path; copy fallback, both mapped explicitly
library.metrics: per-second machine RGB/luma; semantic unknown unless supported by human-viewed evidence
library.integrity: decoded native count, strictly increasing PTS, source SHA256, native JPEG SHA256, per-minute first/middle/last JPEG decode

output.sourceFramePolicy: native source motion; graphics24fps; library60Hz grid is separate

music.durationPolicy: user explicitly requested 60 seconds; duplicate library phrase with crossfade to exact 2880000 sample frames at 48000Hz stereo

render.snapshotAssets: source PNGs for exact offline capture
